## Welcome to Our App!

**Luggage Dimension Converter** helps travelers:
- Convert dimensions from inches to centimeters
- Calculate total size with ease
- Ensure compliance with airline luggage restrictions

Built with **Shiny**, simple UI, and intuitive logic.

---

## Problem Statement

Travelers often struggle to:
- Convert US-size luggage to metric units
- Understand total luggage dimensions
- Know whether it fits airline policies

Our app solves all three with instant, reactive feedback.

---
